notes: Instruction-conditioned streaming V2V editing. Upstream has no streaming server; server.py runs the upstream long_streaming components incrementally (causal LTX-2 encode, SANAStreamingSampler chunk body with fixed-RoPE cache / sink token / 2 cached blocks, causal LTX-2 decode). Each text_control instruction is used verbatim as the editing prompt from the next 24-frame chunk on; caches are kept (no restart, no accumulation of earlier instructions). Source frames are passed through until the first instruction. No reference path (reference_edit not registered).
